_comment: Optional. Copy to config.json to override defaults. With no config.json at all, data lives in ./data/ and the built-in synthetic-TTS format blocklist applies.

discover._format_comment: Substrings (case-insensitive, matched against 'title + channel') that mark a candidate as auto-filtered. Omit this key to keep the built-in synthetic-TTS default in harvest.py; set to [] to disable format filtering entirely.
discover._channel_comment: Channel ids hard-vetoed regardless of taste.json.
